subject.title: Sync vendored shared skills from openclaw/agent-skills

question: Should OpenClaw expand its vendored zero-setup shared-skill snapshot from the existing three skills to all six canonical skills?
rationale: Source inspection proves drift but cannot establish that the three absent skills meet canonical and OpenClaw requirements for baseline bundling rather than optional installation.

options.title: Refresh existing three
options.body: Synchronize `agent-transcript`, `autoreview`, and `crabbox`, record provenance or a parity check, and leave the other skills externally installable.

options.title: Vendor all six
options.body: Adopt all six as required zero-setup OpenClaw tooling and maintain their complete downstream validation surface.

options.title: Split additions
options.body: Land the three established refreshes and evaluate each new bundled skill separately with a concrete OpenClaw use case.

recommendation.title: Refresh existing three
recommendation.body: Synchronize `agent-transcript`, `autoreview`, and `crabbox`, record provenance or a parity check, and leave the other skills externally installable.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across OpenClaw's vendored snapshots and the canonical shared-skill catalog.
